---
title: "Post-Conference Survey"
---

Feedback survey collected after ICRC2023, covering the hybrid meeting format,
program and session structure, conference organization and venues, the
Diversity Session, social events, and overall satisfaction.

- **[Questionnaire](questionnaire.qmd)** — the full list of questions asked

Only the questionnaire is published for the post-conference survey. Its
responses have not been analysed here: the `titanite` pipeline and the
anonymization rules cover the pre-conference survey only. Analysing the
post-conference responses would need its own plugin and a fresh privacy
review.
